title: Scope of practice: the question to ask before you act

lines.say: Scope of practice. The question to ask, before you act.
Your scope is set by your education and your competence. Not by your job title.
It comes from four things together. Education, competence, the setting you work in, and the law.
Not sure if something's in your scope? Ask for supervision before you act. Not after.
And seeing other nurses do it is never the test of whether you're authorised.
In Australia, you work through the N M B A's Decision-Making Framework before you take on an activity.
